expectations.text: B1: Accepts JS with WebGL/three.js and scaffolds accordingly
expectations.evidence: "JavaScript is a fine language for this. The voxel-engine track explicitly lists JS with WebGL/three.js as a supported path"; scaffold given as "voxel/ index.html main.js shaders.js" with TODOs (getContext('webgl2'), compile shaders, VBO + drawArrays) for milestone 1

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: "run a local server (`npx serve` or `python3 -m http.server`) and open the page — you should see a single coloured triangle on a black background. Open devtools console: zero errors."

expectations.text: B3: Names WebGL or three.js as the rendering path
expectations.evidence: "Raw WebGL or three.js? Default: **raw WebGL**" and "WebGL gives you the same GPU pipeline as OpenGL, just through a browser API"

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: Only shell command was "ls .agents/skills/... | grep '^voxel-engine' ; grep -i ... manifest.json" (read-only); FILES WRITTEN IN PROJECT (0); answer states "Never run install commands yourself" and only asks the learner to run npx serve/python3 -m http.server
